titleEn: Number Of Ways To Reconstruct A Tree
title: 重构一棵树的方案数
summary: pairs 表示两节点在有根树中存在祖先后代关系，判断能否构造恰好满足所有关系的树，并返回零种、一种或多种。
insight: 把每个节点的关系集合视为邻接集。根必须与所有其他节点相关；每个非根节点的父节点应是其邻居中度数不小于它且度数最小者，并且该节点其余关系必须包含在父节点关系中。
pitfalls: 找不到与所有节点相关的根则无解
父子度数相等时可交换层次，说明有多解

solutions.title: 度数父节点与邻接包含
solutions.idea: 用祖先关系集合的嵌套性质验证树结构。
steps: 构建每个节点的邻接集合，找 degree=size-1 的 root
对每个非根 node，在邻居中选 degree>=nodeDegree 的最小度数 parent
若不存在 parent 或 node 的任一非 parent 邻居不在 parent 邻接中则返回零；相等度数标记多解

code.java: class Solution { public int checkWays(int[][] pairs){Map<Integer,Set<Integer>> graph=new HashMap<>();for(int[] pair:pairs){graph.computeIfAbsent(pair[0],key->new HashSet<>()).add(pair[1]);graph.computeIfAbsent(pair[1],key->new HashSet<>()).add(pair[0]);}int root=-1;for(int node:graph.keySet())if(graph.get(node).size()==graph.size()-1){root=node;break;}if(root<0)return 0;int answer=1;for(int node:graph.keySet()){if(node==root)continue;int degree=graph.get(node).size(),parent=-1,parentDegree=Integer.MAX_VALUE;for(int neighbor:graph.get(node)){int candidateDegree=graph.get(neighbor).size();if(candidateDegree>=degree&&candidateDegree<parentDegree){parent=neighbor;parentDegree=candidateDegree;}}if(parent<0)return 0;for(int neighbor:graph.get(node))if(neighbor!=parent&&!graph.get(parent).contains(neighbor))return 0;if(parentDegree==degree)answer=2;}return answer;} }
code.kotlin: class Solution { fun checkWays(pairs:Array<IntArray>):Int{val graph=mutableMapOf<Int,MutableSet<Int>>();for(pair in pairs){graph.getOrPut(pair[0]){mutableSetOf()}.add(pair[1]);graph.getOrPut(pair[1]){mutableSetOf()}.add(pair[0])};val root=graph.keys.firstOrNull{graph[it]!!.size==graph.size-1}?:return 0;var answer=1;for(node in graph.keys){if(node==root)continue;val degree=graph[node]!!.size;var parent=-1;var parentDegree=Int.MAX_VALUE;for(neighbor in graph[node]!!){val candidateDegree=graph[neighbor]!!.size;if(candidateDegree>=degree&&candidateDegree<parentDegree){parent=neighbor;parentDegree=candidateDegree}};if(parent<0)return 0;for(neighbor in graph[node]!!)if(neighbor!=parent&&neighbor !in graph[parent]!!)return 0;if(parentDegree==degree)answer=2};return answer} }
code.cpp: class Solution { public: int checkWays(vector<vector<int>>& pairs){unordered_map<int,unordered_set<int>> graph;for(auto& pair:pairs){graph[pair[0]].insert(pair[1]);graph[pair[1]].insert(pair[0]);}int root=-1;for(auto& [node,neighbors]:graph)if(neighbors.size()==graph.size()-1){root=node;break;}if(root<0)return 0;int answer=1;for(auto& [node,neighbors]:graph){if(node==root)continue;int degree=neighbors.size(),parent=-1,parentDegree=INT_MAX;for(int neighbor:neighbors){int candidateDegree=graph[neighbor].size();if(candidateDegree>=degree&&candidateDegree<parentDegree){parent=neighbor;parentDegree=candidateDegree;}}if(parent<0)return 0;for(int neighbor:neighbors)if(neighbor!=parent&&!graph[parent].count(neighbor))return 0;if(parentDegree==degree)answer=2;}return answer;} };
